name: ritim
author: Ediz Ege Mercan
description: Senkron masaustu ve mobil muzik deneyimi

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,SYNC,SOCIAL -c magenta,cyan,yellow "vite --host 0.0.0.0" "tsx watch server/index.ts" "tsx watch server/social.ts"
scripts.desktop: concurrently -k -n WEB,SOCIAL,DESKTOP -c magenta,yellow,green "vite --host 0.0.0.0" "tsx watch server/social.ts" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:8790/health && electron ."
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build
scripts.test:social: node --import tsx --test tests/room-playback-sync.test.cjs tests/social-auth.test.ts tests/social-auth-client.test.cjs tests/social-auth-mobile-races.test.ts tests/social-hub.test.cjs tests/social-infrastructure.test.ts tests/social-security.test.ts tests/sync-server-social-ticket.test.cjs
scripts.test:version: node --test tests/version-policy.test.cjs tests/android-update-plugin.test.cjs && node --import tsx --test tests/mobile-versioning.test.ts
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
